Highly skilled techs with multiple ASE certifications as well as engineering and design experience. Not only do we service and repair GM and Ford vehicles but we also perform high level diagnostics that many other facilities cannot. With OEM and performance industry software and hardware we have unmatched data logging and diagnostics tools and capabilities. We also perform precision chassis and suspension alignments as well as tire balancing with the best Hunter engineering equipment. Our strongest skillset is focused on late model 2001+ GM light duty trucks and SUV as well as 2011+ Ford light duty trucks. Modern turbo diesel vehicles require significantly more experienced technicians and experience that have honed over the last 20+years and can give you not only service and repair recommendations but also performance and drivability enhancements that will improve your driving experience. Whether it's better fuel economy, more power, better handling or nicer ride, we can support you with quality products and industry knowledge that will help you make the best decisions for your ride! | Modern Equipment | ...That's our motto! | With a small shop and a fair amount of Tools and Fabrication equipment we will tackle any job.
